company.name: Foodology
company.shortDescription: Foodology is a cloud kitchen and virtual restaurant company that specializes in creating brands from scratch and scaling them.
company.description: Foodology builds and runs delivery-focused digital restaurant brands. It engages in scaling restaurant brands across Latin America. Its virtual restaurants run through cloud kitchens enabling brands to shorten their iteration cycles and increase their concept offering without incurring significant setup costs. The company operates over 80 kitchens in Colombia, Mexico, Brazil, and Peru.

productsAndServices.description: Foodology creates and scales virtual restaurant brands using cloud kitchen infrastructure.
